newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei to seek listing of unit's shares.
newsitem.headline: Daiei to seek listing of unit's shares.

text.p: Supermarket operator Daiei Inc said on Tuesday that would seek to list the shares of one of its subsidiaries as soon as possible to diversify its sources of fund raising.
Daiei chairman Isao Nakauchi told a news conference that the company is also reviewing its business ties with Sakura Bank Ltd and that it hopes to reach a conclusion by the end of this year.
"We hope to finalise our plan on conducting business with banks before the end of this year," Nakauchi said.

Daiei's debts totalled 600.8 billion yen as of the end of August, down from 629.3 billion yen at the end of February. The company expects that amount to remain at around the same level by the end of the current business year.
